description: Comune di Chieve - Parcheggi is a dataset listed in Regione Lombardia open data portal (www.dati.lombardia.it), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. Posizione e informazioni sui parcheggi. Coverage: Lombardy. The portal files it under the category Protezione Civile. Its tags are aree di sosta, parcheggio, parking. The table has 26 columns. The portal shows 2018-10-11 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-dati-lombardia-it-portal.
